entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... I see an Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered about 77 days ago. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, really. To be honest, the box is still unopened. I ordered it, and then a week later my wife bought me a different helmet as a gift. The color of that one was a better match for my bike, so this one has just been sitting in the closet.

That makes perfect sense. No problem at all. I've checked our policy, and since the helmet was delivered 77 days ago, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.

Excellent, I appreciate that. Now, since this is my first return and I've been a loyal customer for a while, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm already eyeing a new jacket on your site.

Let me check your account status. One moment... Yes, I see you're one of our VIP customers. We definitely value your business. As a thank you, I'd be happy to add a 15% discount code to your account, which you can apply to your next order. How does that sound?
That would be perfect. Thank you for being flexible, David.

Of course. We want to make sure you have the gear you'll actually use. Your safety is our top priority, and that starts with having a helmet you're happy to wear. I've just processed the return approval and the free shipping label is on its way to your email. The 15% code is now active on your account. Can I help with anything else?
No, that's everything. You've made this very simple.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
